  "title": "Risks and open questions",
  "text": "The main risks include deployment delays past 2027-06-30 leading to breach of contract and financial penalties, and cloud hosting providers routing logs through servers outside the United Kingdom causing data residency violations and contract termination [RSK-001, RSK-002]. To respond, we would start training material creation in parallel with system development, establish a phased go-live plan with core modules deployed early, lock down cloud resource deployment scripts to UK-only regions like London, and perform a data flow audit before deployment [RSK-001, RSK-002].
